acceptanceEvidence.allFtlFamiliesAndPathLevels: The balance matrix hard-requires nine FTL families, seven Path levels, and exactly 63 canonical family–Path cases.
acceptanceEvidence.manufacturerAndTopologyCoverage: The balance matrix now hard-fails unless all four manufacturer doctrines and all five topology policies appear in valid generated vessels.
acceptanceEvidence.massVolumeAndGraphClosure: Every case validates canonical contracts, mass and volume closure, module-to-placement parity, graph authority, and source-linked gameplay statistics.
acceptanceEvidence.weaponRegression: Every weapon family remains inside physical reach and the scoped family-priority override proves canonical generation and restoration.
acceptanceEvidence.damageStateInvariants: Condition and post-impact authorities remain separate, immutable source records are retained, and invalid local combat or gameplay states fail validation.
acceptanceEvidence.noUniversalWeaponDominance: The 9,216-trial engagement simulation rejects a weapon family that uniquely dominates every comparable engagement state.
acceptanceEvidence.deterministicReplay: The matrix repeats one canonical case per FTL family and the engagement simulation requires deterministic replay.
acceptanceEvidence.failureArtifacts: Pages uploads matrix and engagement reports even when later validation fails so balance evidence remains inspectable.
